name: CoorPFC
comment: Returns vertices of a parallel flange channel. Argument order is h, b, tf, tw, then optional isRepeatFirstPoint. h is the overall height, b the flange width, tf the flange thickness, and tw the web thickness. The web lies on x = 0 and the flanges extend to x = b. The section is centered on y = 0. Vertex order starts at the top of the web and runs around the profile. isRepeatFirstPoint defaults to FALSE; TRUE appends the first vertex again. Non-numeric sizes return #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
